theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_ic_inverse_linepow
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) (τ : UpperHalfPlane), (HeckeEis.binaryFormRepSL ℂ n) σ⁻¹ (HeckeEis.linePow n ((σ • τ : UpperHalfPlane) : ℂ)) = ((HeckeEis.jFactor σ τ) ^ n)⁻¹ • HeckeEis.linePow n (τ : ℂ)
theorems.natural_summary: Apply the inverse representation to the pinned forward line-power identity. Cancel the representation factors, move the scalar through the linear map, and multiply by its reciprocal. Nonvanishing of jFactor ensures cancellation for every n, including zero.
